about: Generated by conformance/family_oracle (make family-vectors). Do not edit by hand.
Every derived value comes from the independent Python oracle, never from Rust.
Rust tests read the inputs, recompute the outputs, and compare.
The cases are the registered vectors of quip/polariton-static revision 1, generated by polariton.py.
A case lists the salts that build in its instances and the salts that give code 14 in its skipped list.

The witnesses section holds, for the first instance of each case, one feasible witness and one infeasible witness with low energy. A witness holds one spin per instance node. An entry gives the expected feasible result, the direct charges, the number of violated labels, the charge loss in milli, and the encoded energy in milli.
The polariton_recipes section holds the registered parameter sets on the live z(12, 4) topology with two salts each. It stores hashes, the window, and the charge try that passed, not instances.
The admission section holds requests with their expected admission codes.
